title: Media Enquiries | Contact FNPW Press and PR Team

blocks.v: The Foundation for National Parks & Wildlife is the charity partner of Australia’s national parks. Our programs and conservation efforts, including grant funding, support the broader mission of safeguarding Australia’s wilderness and wildlife for future generations.
For further information and to get in touch with the Foundation for National & Wildlife, please fill out the contact form below.
For media specific enquiries, including interview requests, please contact media@fnpw.org.au
Please fill out the media enquiry form below and we will be in touch with you shortly. Thank you.
